LanguageData.RR_Evidence_Unregistered: Somebody left this here before you. It has no case record on this branch yet - carry it out and take it home, and it will open one.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_NextStep: Right-click it with a colonist to carry it out. Take it home, put it on the shelf you designate as the records archive, then analyse it at a powered field analysis bench.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_InvalidRecord: The recording cannot be linked to this coordinate and case. Preserve it and review the case record.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_NotReady: Analysis requires all six required room surveys, a recorded route mismatch, the secured recording, a powered headquarters analysis bench and a capable researcher with Intellectual 4.
LanguageData.RR_Event_EvidenceSecured: The record book is at headquarters. Complete the route and distortion observations, shelve it in the records archive, then assign a researcher to analysis.
LanguageData.RR_Event_SurveySettled: Survey accepted after physical evidence analysis. Company Account receipt: ${0} USD.
LanguageData.RR_Event_SurveyBonus: All three original crew returned with the required observations. Company Account bonus: ${0} USD.
LanguageData.RR_Research_MissingProject: The saved company project definition is unavailable. Restore the required Rimrooms content before proceeding.
LanguageData.RR_Research_ProjectAlreadyActive: Finish the active company project before starting another.
LanguageData.RR_Research_NeedsPrerequisite: An earlier project has to be finished before this one can begin.
LanguageData.RR_Research_NeedsRouteLogs: Not enough completed route logs. Survey more coordinates, bring the books home to an archive shelf, and analyse them.
LanguageData.RR_Research_NeedsDistortionLogs: Not enough completed distortion logs. This needs records of the space itself misbehaving while somebody was recording, which a branch that has only had quiet runs will not have.
LanguageData.RR_Research_NeedsEntityLogs: Not enough completed entity logs. The company will not authorise this on the word of a crew that has never met anything down there.
LanguageData.RR_Research_NeedsInsight: Analyze recovered evidence to earn the insight this project needs.
LanguageData.RR_Research_NotReady: Research requires an active company project and a qualified researcher working at a powered headquarters analysis bench.
LanguageData.RR_Event_EvidenceAnalyzed: {0} completed the physical evidence analysis. One research insight was recorded.
LanguageData.RR_UI_LabInstructions: Designate an existing research bench above, then assign Research work to an available researcher with Intellectual 4 or higher. Secured evidence is analyzed before active company research. Native bench efficiency applies; a hi-tech bench needs power. Keep physical access to the interaction cell and evidence. Clearing the company designation leaves ordinary research available.
LanguageData.RR_UI_TelemetryLocked: Gate Telemetry unlocks planning from your surveyed room records.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_SiteUnavailable: The coordinate's existing map is unavailable. Recover its saved site before creating or moving evidence.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_NoSafeSlot: No reachable evidence position was found in the generated office. Keep the gate closed and review the coordinate.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_PreviousObjectMissing: This coordinate's evidence was already created. Its loss is preserved; revisiting does not create a second copy.
LanguageData.RR_UI_EvidenceChecklist: Required room survey: {0}\nRequired route mismatch: {1}\nOptional entity observation: {2}
LanguageData.RR_UI_EvidenceFieldWorkRemaining: Carry the record book through each required room. At the corridor junction, set a glow pod down and designate it as a numbered marker before investigating the next passage. A second marker at the last good junction gives you something stable to compare against. Incomplete observations can be finished on a later trip to the same site.
LanguageData.RR_UI_AnalysisSnapshotNote: This report preserves the observations available when analysis finished.
LanguageData.RR_UI_LegacyReportUnavailable: This older analyzed record has no saved observation details. Its recorded completion remains valid.
LanguageData.RR_UI_ReportUnavailable: No detailed field observations were available for this report.
LanguageData.RR_UI_NoFieldObservations: No witnessed observations have been recorded yet.
LanguageData.RR_UI_ObservationWitness: Witness: {0}. Branch day {1}. Recorder carried by {2}.
LanguageData.RR_UI_InterviewPrompt: Two crew do not agree about this. {0} can take both statements and file one of them as the company’s version; the other stays on the record either way.
LanguageData.RR_UI_AccountFiled: Filed: the company accepts {0}’s account, after an interview by {1} on day {2}. The other account remains on the record.
LanguageData.RR_Interview_NoInterviewer: Nobody on staff can take a statement about this. An interviewer needs Social {0}, has to be awake, able to talk and not one of the crew who gave an account.
LanguageData.RR_Interview_Inactive: The branch is not operating, so nothing can be filed.
LanguageData.RR_Interview_RecordUnavailable: That record or that observation is no longer on the company’s books.
LanguageData.RR_Interview_RecordClosed: Analysis on this record is already complete. A filed conclusion is not reopened; the disagreement stays on the record as it was when the report was written.
LanguageData.RR_Interview_NoSuchAccount: That account is not on this observation.
LanguageData.RR_Interview_WitnessUnavailable: The person who gave that account is dead or no longer employed here, so the company will not file it on their behalf.
LanguageData.RR_Interview_InterviewerUnavailable: The interviewer is unavailable. They must be employed, awake, able to talk, and not in a mental break.
LanguageData.RR_Interview_InterviewerIsWitness: That staff member gave one of these accounts. Somebody else has to take the statements.
LanguageData.RR_Interview_InterviewerUnskilled: That staff member is not experienced enough with people to take a statement the company will file.
LanguageData.RR_UI_AccountAgrees: Corroborated by {0} on day {1}: the same junction, room {2}, marker {3}.
LanguageData.RR_UI_AccountDisagrees: Disputed by {0} on day {1}: they place it at room {2}, marker {3}. The company has filed the first account and kept theirs on the record.
LanguageData.RR_Observation_room_survey: Room {0}: surveyed with the crew’s record book in hand.
LanguageData.RR_Observation_route_mismatch: Room {0}: survey marker {2} was found here despite being placed in room {1}.
LanguageData.RR_Observation_recorder_gap: Room {0}: the field recording contains a gap around marker {2}'s displacement from room {1}. The cause remains unresolved.
LanguageData.RR_Observation_entity_sighting: Entity reported in room {0}; the witnessing crew member was in room {1}. Its origin remains unknown.
